newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets software deal with TU-KA.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets software deal with TU-KA.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Cellular Infrastructure Group said Monday TU-KA Cellular Tokyo signed a multi-million dollar contract to deploy Motorola's Dynamic Equipment Sharing (DES) software on its wireless phone network.
The software will be used on TU-KA's Personal Digital Cellular network, and Motorola said it is the first time the technology will be used on a wireless phone network.
Installation of the software was recently completed, the company said. DES enables the cellular base stations to respond more efficiently to peak phone usage, reducing the likelihood of busy signals.
TU-KA launched its PDC network in 1994. The network covers the Kanto area of Tokyo.
